name: codex-bt
description: Let Codex operate Baota (BT) Linux panel 13.0 through the MCP protocol — diagnose sites/databases/services, audit security, and drive 98 panel tools via Streamable HTTP + Bearer Token.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Baota Linux panel via MCP
interface.longDescription: Routes Codex to operate Baota (BT) Linux panel 13.0 through the MCP protocol. Diagnoses sites/databases/services, audits security, manages Docker, SSL, cron, and firewall. The plugin ships no local MCP server — connect your Codex/ZCode/Kimi client to a remote Baota MCP endpoint at port 8765 with Bearer Token auth.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Baota panel and run a read-only health check
Diagnose why my Baota-hosted site is slow
Audit the Baota panel's security and list the top issues
